ayahOccurrences.text: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَصَكَّتْ is in the derivative form: صَكَّ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ص/ك/ك   ṣ–k–k to slap with the hand, violent strike with a ringing sound; to shut, to close. Of this root, 1 form, صَكَّت ṣakkat, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
صَكَّ ṣakka u [v. trans.] to slap, smack, smite with loud noise

(51:29) فَأَقْبَلَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا then his wife entered with a loud cry, and struck her [own] face.
